name: agent-orchestrator
description: Local-agent-first kanban orchestrator for coding agents

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:server: TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.server.json nodemon --watch src/server --watch src/shared --ext ts --exec "node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only src/server/main.ts"
scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run build:server && npm run build:web
